newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Shell Singapore cuts refinery output to 95-pct. [CORRECTED 10:05 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Shell Singapore cuts refinery output to 95-pct. [CORRECTED 10:05 GMT]

text.p: Shell Singapore plans to cut Friday output at its 435,000-bpd refinery to just under 95 percent, a company spokeswoman said on Friday.
"We have just taken the decision to cut runs by 4,000 tonnes (corrects from 4 kilolitres) per day which is just under 95 percent of capacity," she said.
The spokeswomen said the cut will take effect from today and will continue for an indefinite period.
She cited weak refining margins as one of the key factors for the cut.
Traders said plunging product prices in Singapore this week have pushed primary refining margins for most crude into the red with the margin for Arab Light swinging to a $1 per barrel loss.
Shell's refinery is located at Pulau Bukom, off Singapore's south coast.
